create_sandbox_container: create a LocalContainerBackend instance to start a new sandbox container with a given image, base port, and environment variables
discover_running_sandbox: discover an existing running sandbox container by its deterministic sandbox ID and return its connection info
list_running_sandboxes: list all running sandbox containers matching the configured prefix with a single batched docker inspect call
destroy_sandbox_container: destroy a sandbox container by stopping it and releasing its allocated port
check_sandbox_alive: check if a sandbox container is still running using a lightweight docker inspect call
